'''Suliana''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|Agriworld]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] where fields of [[cotton]] grew.

==Environment==
Year round, planet wide warmth provided by it rotation speed and distance from its large sun ([[Star/Legends|Type-F star]]) gave the planet Suliana very optimal conditions for the farming of its [[cotton]]. Its [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|produce]] was famed throughout the sector, and its position on the junction of five sub [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] routes made the planet even more successful.

==Government==
The planet remained the possession of [[House Hax]]; however, it was also home to many from houses [[House Petro|Petro]] and [[House Picutorion|Picutorion]].
